participant_1.name: Kevin
participant_1.personality: Reflective and passionate about music, Kevin has a nurturing side as a single dad.
participant_1.background: I'm a recording engineer and own my own studio. My ex cheated and left me for a lawyer. I am a 46-year-old single dad with kids. I live in California, but the recording artist market was dead last year. I prefer being inside.

participant_2.name: Sophia
participant_2.personality: Enthusiastic and community-oriented, Sophia loves sharing her musical talents and helping others.
participant_2.background: I volunteer at the homeless shelter. My father played violin professionally. I am a piano teacher on the side and play several instruments. I enjoy exploring new parts of the city.
